question: What can WesBot help me with?
variants: What can you check for me?
answer: WesBot can check products and live availability, your reservations, payment status, digital receipts, pickup information, and published WESCOMM FAQs. You can also ask to talk to Commissary Staff.

question: Does WesBot guess prices, stock, or reservation status?
variants: Accurate ba stock na sinasabi ni WesBot?
Nanghuhula ba si WesBot ng presyo?
Live ba ang data ni WesBot?
answer: No. WesBot is designed to use verified WESCOMM records for prices, stock, reservation status, payment facts, receipt facts, dates, and policies. If it cannot verify an answer, it should ask for more details or direct you to Staff.

question: Can I talk to Commissary Staff instead of WesBot?
variants: Can I talk to a real person?
answer: Yes. You can choose Talk to Staff. The conversation will be placed in the Commissary Staff queue and WesBot automatic replies will be paused for that conversation.

question: What happens after I request Staff support?
variants: Ano mangyayari pag nag Talk to Staff ako?
Will WesBot still reply after handoff?
answer: Your conversation moves to the Staff queue. WesBot automatic replies are paused while the conversation is waiting for or being handled by Staff.

question: When will WesBot recommend Staff assistance?
variants: Bakit nire-recommend ni WesBot ang staff?
Ilang ulit bago mag suggest ng staff?
answer: If the same concern reaches the third repeated WesBot reply, the current bot logic recommends Staff assistance. You can still ask for Staff directly at any time.

question: How can I check my reservation status?
answer: Ask WesBot for your reservation status. If you provide a WES reference code, it checks that reservation in your account; otherwise it checks your active or most recent reservation.

question: Can I cancel my reservation while it is Pending?
variants: Can I cancel a pending reservation?
answer: A student may self-cancel their own reservation only while it is Pending and only when the payment state does not require Staff review.

question: Can I directly cancel a Confirmed reservation?
variants: Confirmed na, cancel ko pa ba?
answer: No. Once a reservation is no longer Pending, the student cannot self-cancel it directly. Cancellation review must be handled by authorized Staff or an Administrator.

question: Can I cancel a reservation that already has a successful Online GCash payment?
answer: Do not self-cancel a reservation with a successful Online GCash payment. Authorized Staff or an Administrator must review the cancellation and any required refund handling.

question: How does WesBot check my payment status?
answer: WesBot checks the payment record linked to your reservation. It reports only the recorded payment status and, when available, the verified paid time.

question: What does Pay at Commissary mean?
variants: May online payment ba pag pay at commissary?
answer: For a reservation set to Pay at Commissary, WesBot reports that no online payment is recorded for that reservation.

question: What payment statuses can appear for Online GCash?
answer: The current system can record these online payment states: Initializing, Awaiting Payment, Paid, Expired, Cancelled, Staff Refund Review Required, Partially Refunded, and Refunded.

question: How can I check my digital receipt?
answer: Ask WesBot about your receipt. If you provide an RCT receipt code, it checks that receipt in your account; otherwise it checks your most recent receipt.

question: What receipt statuses are used by WESCOMM?
answer: The current receipt states are Pending, Verified, and Voided.

question: How do I know my pickup schedule?
variants: Where can I see pickup window?
answer: WesBot can check the pickup start and end time recorded on your reservation. It also reports the reservation status together with the pickup window.

question: What if my reservation has no pickup window yet?
answer: If no pickup window has been assigned yet, wait for confirmation or ask Commissary Staff for help.

question: Can WesBot check live product stock and price?
answer: Yes. Product questions are checked against the current WESCOMM catalog. When a product has variants, WesBot can report the available options and their current stock.

question: What should I include when asking about a product?
answer: For the best match, include the item name and, when applicable, the course or department and preferred size or option.

question: Can I add or remove products from my wishlist?
answer: Signed-in student accounts can add active products to the wishlist and remove them later.

question: Can WESCOMM notify me when a wished product is back in stock?
answer: WESCOMM includes back-in-stock notification support for wishlist products when inventory availability changes.

question: Can I mark notifications as read?
answer: Yes. The current notification API supports viewing notifications, checking the unread count, marking one notification as read, and marking all notifications as read.

question: What profile information can I update myself?
answer: You can update your full name, phone number, department, and address in your own profile. Student number is not included in the self-editable profile fields.

question: What happens on the first and second confirmed no-show?
answer: Under the current automatic no-show policy, the first consecutive confirmed no-show creates warning 1 and the second creates warning 2. The second warning is the final warning before reservation access may be suspended.

question: When can repeated no-shows suspend reservation access?
answer: The current policy starts the first automatic reservation restriction at 3 consecutive confirmed no-shows. The first restriction lasts 7 days, the next restriction level lasts 30 days, and a level 3 restriction is indefinite pending Administrator review.

question: Is there a grace period before a reservation can be recorded as no-show?
answer: The current no-show policy uses a 24-hour grace period after the recorded pickup end time before the reservation becomes eligible for no-show processing.

question: What can I still access if my reservation access is restricted?
variants: Can I still see receipts when restricted?
answer: A reservation restriction blocks reservation access, but the student can still view receipts and contact Support.
